newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore share trading to resume at 1:15 pm -SES.
newsitem.headline: Singapore share trading to resume at 1:15 pm -SES.

text.p: The Stock Exchange of Singapore said on Monday trading would resume at 0515 GMT (1.15 pm) and would be extended to 1000 GMT (6. pm) after a technical fault halted dealing for several hours.
Trading was interrupted shortly after the market opened at 0100 GMT.
The benchmark Straits Times Industrials Index was last seen down 0.64 points at 2,018.96.
